payload.question: How long does it take to sort out a new housing benefit claim?
payload.label: Days to process a new housing benefit claim, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council's own explanation: "This reflects the increasing complexity of remaining caseloads following the migration of Housing Benefit to Universal Credit… We are also experiencing delays in receiving necessary data from housing providers." It also notes it raised its own target from 19.5 to 21 days this quarter, because England's average was 21. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: Someone who has just claimed housing benefit is usually short of money now. The council aims to settle a new claim in 21 days and says it will step in past 22. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it averaged 22.6 days across 351 claims — the council rates this red on its own dashboard, and so does the rule.
